title: AgriPulse Empirical Highland Coffee Agro-Climatic Dataset
target_persona: Noor (Ondera Highlands, Aberdares / Mt. Kenya coffee belt)

sources.name: UN WFP Food Prices (HDX)
sources.provider: United Nations World Food Programme / UN OCHA
sources.license: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)

sources.name: iSDAsoil
sources.coverage: 30m resolution pH and clay fraction for East African volcanic soils

epidemiological_ground_truth.germination_conditions: Continuous free leaf moisture (RH >= 82% or rain > 1.0mm) + 19.5-25.5°C

limitations_and_gap_analysis:
1. Satellite coarse resolution (0.5°) smooths hyper-local valley fogs and ridge-top microclimates.
2. Topographical micro-aspects (sunward vs leeward slopes) receive distinct solar radiation.
3. Mitigation: System implements Temperature-Scaled Uncertainty Calibration and human signposting.
